categories.main_business_segments: ONEOK operates through four main business segments: Natural Gas Gathering and Processing, Natural Gas Liquids, Natural Gas Pipelines, and Refined Products and Crude. The Refined Products and Crude segment was added in 2023 following the acquisition of Magellan Midstream Partners, significantly expanding the company's asset base and service offerings.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core operations rely on an extensive pipeline network (over 50,000 miles) and associated infrastructure for gathering, processing, fractionation, transportation, storage, and export of natural gas, NGLs, refined products, and crude oil. Key technologies include natural gas processing plants, NGL fractionators, storage facilities, and marine terminals, with ongoing investments in electrification, system optimization, and emissions mitigation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ONEOK serves a diverse customer base including major and independent oil and gas producers, petrochemical companies, propane distributors, utilities, refiners, wholesalers, retailers, airlines, railroads, and large industrial companies. End markets span retail fueling stations, airports, utilities, and export markets, with a focus on connecting supply basins to major demand centers and export facilities.
categories.geographic_coverage: ONEOK’s operations are concentrated in North America, with assets spanning the Mid-Continent, Rocky Mountain, Permian Basin, Gulf Coast, and Midwest regions of the United States. The company’s pipeline and terminal network covers 15 states and connects to key export markets, including cross-border connections to Mexico and Canada.
categories.supply_chain_position: ONEOK is a leading midstream service provider, operating primarily in the midstream segment of the energy supply chain. The company gathers, processes, transports, stores, and distributes natural gas, NGLs, refined products, and crude oil, acting as an intermediary between upstream producers and downstream end users or export markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include safety (zero-incident culture), workforce engagement, maintaining financial strength, and maximizing shareholder returns through disciplined capital allocation and growth projects. ONEOK is focused on sustainable operations, emissions reduction (targeting a 30% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions by 2030), and exploring renewable energy and low-carbon opportunities to complement its midstream assets.
categories.revenue_model: The company primarily generates revenue through fee-based contracts for gathering, processing, transportation, storage, and terminal services, as well as commodity sales (natural gas, NGLs, refined products, and crude oil). Over 85% of consolidated earnings are fee-based, with additional revenue from optimization, marketing, and product sales activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ONEOK competes with other major midstream companies, integrated oil companies, and independent E&P firms with similar infrastructure. Key competitors include Energy Transfer, EnLink Midstream, Enterprise Products Partners, Kinder Morgan, MPLX, NuStar Energy, Plains All American Pipeline, Targa Resources, Western Midstream, and Williams Companies. ONEOK is positioned as one of the largest diversified energy infrastructure companies in North America, with strategic assets in prolific supply basins and major demand centers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For 2023, ONEOK reported total revenues of $17.7 billion, net income of $2.7 billion, and adjusted EBITDA of $5.2 billion. The company completed the $14.1 billion acquisition of Magellan Midstream Partners in 2023, significantly increasing its asset base and scale. ONEOK targets steady dividend growth (3-4% annually) and maintains investment-grade credit ratings, with a focus on prudent financial management and capital allocation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ONEOK emphasizes its integrated, diversified, and strategically located asset base, enabling reliable, safe, and efficient delivery of energy products to key markets. The company’s fee-based business model reduces commodity price exposure, while its focus on sustainability, operational excellence, and customer service differentiates it in the midstream sector. The recent Magellan acquisition further enhances its scale, diversification, and ability to deliver value-added solutions for a transforming energy future.
